name: Seated Hamstring Curl
instructions: Sit in the machine with the pad above your heels and the thigh pad secured.
Curl your heels back and down toward your glutes.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: A machine seated hamstring curl that isolates the hamstrings.

sources.title: Original to the LIFT knowledge base

safetyNotes: Use a moderate weight; stop with cramping or sharp pain.
